fields.name: Hiraṇya dāsa (Majumdār, Saptagrāma)
fields.notes: A kāyastha, brother of Govardhana Majumdār, rulers of Saptagrāma, and paternal uncle of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī (CC Madhya 16.217-219). Their pāṭabāḍī at Kṛṣṇapura on the Sarasvatī; the family Deity Rādhā-Govinda, believed to be the one now at Khenksiyālī (Chinsurā). Not Hiraṇya Paṇḍita of Navadvīpa (#502). (The disciples field said «Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī»: he was his nephew.)

fields.place: Born in Calcutta; Europe and America (New York); Calcutta (from 1909)
fields.disciples: Kṛṣṇa Gopāla Duggul of the Punjab; some 5,000 in America

fields.name: Mānasiṁha (Rājā of Āmber)
fields.place: Āmber; Vṛndāvana (temple of Govindadeva); Kāśī (Rāmajī, Māna-sarovara); Bengal (Subahdār)
fields.notes: Son of Bhagavān dāsa of the Pṛthvīrāja family of Āmber; Mansabdār of 5,000 under Akbar and Subahdār of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa (1600); a Vaiṣṇava who built the temple of Govindadeva in Vṛndāvana and arranged His service, and temples at Kāśī. Died 1614. (The guru field said «Bhagavana dāsa»: his father.)
